title: Missing upper bound check for select_channel result
description: At line 181, the test only asserts ch >= 1 ('Never returns CH0'). It does not verify the channel is within the plan's valid range. For EU868 with 8 channels (indices 0-7), if select_channel returns 8 (which it can: 1+(h%8) where h%8=7), that would be out of bounds for frequency() calls.
